messages:
maria: FYI I noticed a header rewrite on corp VPN that adds an email-like value to X-User-Ident for /v1/relay. A few sampled records ended up in analytics. possible PII leak.

jon: Can you paste an anonymized example? :eyes:

maria: Example (sanitized): `INFO relay req_id=abc123 route=/v1/relay headers={..., X-User-Ident: alice@example.com} sampled=true body_attached=true`. Repro from corp VPN via curl.

ashwin: That explains the recent spike. Our sampler enforces route-rate + global but has no per-route body-export deny. We must avoid fragile header regex scrubbing.

katie: Proposal: add route metadata `sensitive: true|false`. If true, sampler enforces `export_body=false` and `export_headers=allowlist`. Console exposes strict-mode and an auditable breakglass for temporary inspect.

jon: Are there legitimate debug cases that need bodies for those routes? If so, breakglass should write only to ephemeral audit store, not analytics.

ashwin: Implementation sketch: (1) route metadata + migration; (2) sampler consults route.sensitive and sets export flags; (3) console shows sensitivity badge + override with audit log.

maria: Can we surface candidates automatically? Heuristic: header values with `@` or email pattern >0.1% of requests/day → mark candidate in UI (no auto-flip).

ashwin: Add metric `route_pii_indicator_rate` and alert if >0.05% AND sampled_with_body>0.

jon: Draft route config (WIP): `routes: - id: relay-v1 path: /v1/relay sensitive: true sampling: policy: route-aware`

katie: UX: require two-step confirmation + compliance tag to move sensitive->false. Dashboard card: "sampled_with_body" count + scrubbed preview that redacts emails.

sre-bot: deploy: /services/relay updated (deploy id dpl-2026-02-12-03) — PR #3210 by @devops modified header propagation.

maria: PR #3210 likely introduced the header propagation; missed analytics export impact. I'll paste PR link and affected req_ids.

ashwin: Action items: katie -> console mock + breakglass copy (ETA today); ashwin -> metric + alert rule (ETA tomorrow); jon -> sampler check + feature-flagged PR (end of week); maria -> list of affected req_ids and purge ticket for security/compliance.

katie: I'll include legal copy for the breakglass flow and a mock that shows candidate flagging. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll add unit tests asserting export_body=false for sensitive routes and gate behind a feature flag.

maria: I'm going to purge the identified sampled records and run a quick search for other routes with email-like headers. Will post results here.

legal-bot: Note: any purge must include an audit trail and approval from security/compliance. Please create ticket SEC-2026-045.

ashwin: Also add a console alert type "PII candidate detected" linking to the route and showing `route_pii_indicator_rate`. Owners can remediate before leaks escalate.

maria: If folks see other headers with `@` pattern drop them here. Posting PR and purge ticket when done.

jon: Thanks all — nice catch and clear next steps.
